title: The bowl
decides: Is time alone a reason to split? One scene, one continuous action, 30 s.
setting: A small pottery studio in soft morning window light, warm earth tones, shallow depth of field. One continuous shot with a slow push in.

subjects.words: A potter in her fifties with short grey curls, a clay-stained denim apron and rolled sleeves

beats.text: She centres a ball of wet clay on the spinning wheel with both palms.
She presses her thumbs into the centre and opens the clay into a thick ring.
She pulls the wall upward between her fingers and the bowl grows taller.
She widens the rim with a wooden rib and the curve flares outward.
She smooths the lip with a wet sponge as the wheel slows.
She cuts the bowl free with a wire and lifts it toward the window light.

checks: Six actions, each once, in order
Same potter, apron and studio from start to end
